name: cn-zhuanjingtexin-application
description: Prepare an application under China's tiered SME programme: 创新型中小企业, 专精特新中小企业 and 专精特新小巨人. Identify the right tier, test the company against the specialisation, refinement, distinctiveness and innovation indicators, plan the evidence, and write the application narrative. Use when asked 专精特新怎么申报, 专精特新中小企业认定条件, 小巨人申报条件, 我们够不够专精特新, 创新型中小企业评价, or prepare our Specialised SME application. Produces a tier recommendation, an indicator self-assessment, a gap plan, a materials checklist, narrative sections and a timeline. Not an official assessment.
